Post Date: 2021-08-26T13:36:31Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: How can I check completion of saving which is processed  in async way?
Description: Hi. could you please clarify how I can wait async execution of saving?
I Have the following methods in repository class.
```
public Completable save(Book book) {
        // logic to save book in DB
    }

public Single<Boolean> exist(Book book) {
        // logic to check if book exists in DB
    }
```
And there is method in service that uses _save_ method from repository
```
public Single<Book> saveBook(Book book) {
        bookRepo.save(book);
        return Sing.just(book);
    }
```

The problem is that after _saveBook_ method execution the book may not be in the database as saving is processed  in async way.
How can I change me _saveBook_ method using _exist_ method to be sure that after _saveBook_ method execution I will have the book in DB?
